annotations.title: Money in and out of a company

description: Needs an Alion account or an x402 payment (not free on this open address). The money ledger of one company, newest first, up to 200 rows a call: rounds and other equity, debt, grants, public contracts won, customers' contracts, acquisitions and stakes bought, capital spending, supply deals, revenue as stated, lobbying, taxes and payroll where filed - each row with its kind, direction (in/out), stage (announced, signed, paid, estimate), the counterparty (a person reads "Individuals"), the amount in USD and as stated, a post-money valuation where one is named, and the link to its own source. The head sums the paid-in money, what is signed and not yet paid, and what the company agreed to spend. Filter by kind, direction, since and min_usd; page with offset. For due diligence, investor research and account planning. Premium: $0.05 a call that answers with rows (nothing found costs nothing). Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

company.description: The company: its domain ("openai.com"), Alion id or name.

direction.description: in = money the company takes, out = money it pays.

kind.description: One kind or a comma list: revenue, equity, donation, debt, grant, public_contract, contract_won, invested_in, sold, secondary, dividend, buyback, supply, capex, acquisition, investment, tax, payroll, lobbying, political, settlement, revenue_share, grant_given, lease.

min_usd.description: Only rows of at least this many US dollars.

since.description: Only rows dated after this point: an ISO date or a window ("1y", "6m").

name: get_company_money

has_data.description: false: nothing on file, and the call is not paid

items.description: money: ledger rows {kind, direction, stage, source_kind, counterparty, what, date, amount_usd, post_money_valuation_usd, source_url}

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)

mark.description: People tools: the code of this account and UTC day; every list of people read today carries it

tier.description: anonymous, free, pro, partner or staff

summary.description: money: sums of paid-in, signed and committed money, rows by kind

title: Money in and out of a company
